shellCommands.command: git status --short && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100

cat app/ContactForm.tsx; echo ---PAGE---; cat app/page.tsx; echo ---LAYOUT---; cat app/layout.tsx; echo ---RUN---; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs; echo ---DIFF---; git diff; echo ---TSCONFIG---; cat tsconfig.json next.config.ts
ls node_modules >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "node_modules present" || echo "no node_modules"; npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | tail -20
git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short
